{{Top|leg}}
A '''shoulder-mounted blaster''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] installed in the [[battle armor]] used by [[Cydon Prax]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Requiring different skills to operate than other blaster weapons, the shoulder-mounted blaster was significantly more powerful than the [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] carried by Prax.<ref name="CP">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031211prax|text=Cydon Prax}}</ref> The [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], also known as "the Exterminator," sported a shoulder-mounted blaster.
